_note: Sourced from DS_MN820 v1.0 (src MN820), VM820C DS v1.1 (src VM820C), BT820 DS v1.1 (src BT820), Hirose DF40 catalog (src DF40), Diodes AP63200/1/3/5 DS (src AP6320x). 'derived' = arithmetic on sourced values, not stated in source.

module.description: BT820 Mini Module, with on-board 1Gbit DDR3L SDRAM

supply.rail_name_on_connector: VCC3V3 (CN1 pins 13,15,17,19). Table 2 labels them '3.3V output power supply' but per section 5.1 this is the module's single power input (VM820C drives VCC3V3 into CN6 13/15/17/19).
supply.src_vin: MN820 Table 3 (VCC3V3 3.0/3.3/3.6 V) and section 5.1 ('accepts an input voltage in the range of 3.0 to 3.6 volts')
supply.icc_typ_condition: VCC=3V3, measured while displaying a test card
supply.internal_rails: Module internally generates 1.1V for core operation and 1.35V for the onboard DDR3L (MN820 section 5.1). [BT820 DS lists VCC10K nominal 1.0V, 0.9-1.1V.]
supply.baseboard_reference_current: VM820C Table 17: Icc_USB_5V typ 397 mA into USB_5V with 10.1in 1920x1200 LCD, ILED 42.5 mA (whole baseboard incl. backlight)

io_dc_levels_module.test_currents: NOT_FOUND (MN820 Table 3 gives no IOH/IOL test conditions)
io_dc_levels_module.chip_level_reference: BT820 Table 21 (VCCIO=3.3V): VOH min VCCIO-0.4, VOL max 0.4, VIH min 2.0, VIL max 0.8; no test current stated
io_dc_levels_module.io_voltage_note: VM820C/MN820 run all BT820 VCCIO from 3.3V per module design; MN820 DS does not separately document VCCIO1 strapping. Host I/O therefore 3.3V LVCMOS.

LVDS_TX.detail: 2 channels x (4 data + 1 clock): LVDS_TX0_{D0..D3,CLK}_{P,N} = odd channel (pins 57-75), LVDS_TX1_{D0..D3,CLK}_{P,N} = even channel (pins 79-97). Single-channel panels use TX0 only (BT820 4.2).

LVDS_RX.vm820c_note: VM820C places 100R differential termination resistors across each LVDS_RX pair on the baseboard (R4,R9,R15,R19,R18,R25,R33,R41,R49,R47 in VM820C schematic sheet 4)

host_QSPI.vm820c_pulls: VM820C sheet 4 'MCU HOST INTERFACE': SPIS_SS_N 10k pull-up (R82) to VCC3V3; INT_N 10k pull-up (R81); RESET_N 47k pull-up (R76) + 0.1uF to GND (C62); SPIS_MISO, SPIS_MOSI, SPIS_IO2, SPIS_IO3 each 10k pull-down to GND (R83-R86). VM820C also has 33R series resistors on host paths (R90-R97, R64-R74/R98, R87).
host_QSPI.bt820_requirement: BT820 4.5.2: data ports must have pull-downs (bus turnaround polling period).

SPI_flash_master_SPIM.vm820c_use: W25N01GVZEIG 1Gbit SPI NAND (U4) on VM820C; 10k pull-ups R43, R37, R36 to VCC3V3 on flash control/IO lines (VM820C sheet 4)

SD_card.vm820c_use: microSD socket CN1 with 10k pull-ups (R26-R31) and 33R series resistors

audio.type: sigma-delta PWM outputs (VM820C: 33R series R40/R42, then 74LVC2G125 buffer + 3-stage RC LPF to 3.5mm jack)

I2S.note: I2S_LRCLK/I2S_BCLK are inputs to module, I2S_SDA output (MN820 Table 2)

display_control.vm820c: BKLIT_PWM via 33R (R59) to TPS61500 EN; DISP direct

touch.note: No dedicated touch pins; BT820 alternate functions on GPIO5=TP_SCL (pin 76), GPIO6=TP_SDA (pin 74), GPIO7=TP_INT_N (pin 78), GPIO8=TP_RST_N (pin 80) (BT820 Table 13). Touch I/O on VCCIO1 (same as host QSPI).
touch.vm820c_pullups: CN9 CTP: GPIO8/CTP_RST# 1k (R53), GPIO7/CTP_INT# 1k (R61), GPIO5/CTP_SCL 1k (R67), GPIO6/CTP_SDA 10k (R63) to VCC3V3 (as drawn in VM820C sheet 4)

pcba_dimensions_mm.src: MN820 3.1 ('49 mm x 29 mm x 3.74 mm') and Figure 14

mounting_holes.positions_mm_top_view: both at X=46.5 from left edge (i.e. 2.5 from right edge of 49 mm board); Y=2.5 and Y=26.5 from bottom edge (24.0 mm apart)
mounting_holes.hole_diameter: NOT_FOUND on MN820 drawing (only 'screw -> M2.5'); VM820C Figure 12 shows mating baseboard holes '2 * holes diameter 2.7' spaced 24.0

mechanical.emi_shield: footprint for 44 x 28 mm shield, min height >1.5 mm; 4 slots 3 x 0.4 mm (MN820 5.4, Figure 14)

connector.part: Hirose DF40C-100DP-0.4V(51) (plug), on module bottom side
connector.position: Figure 15 (bottom view): connector centre 6.2 mm from the left (short) board edge, 15.5 mm from the lower long edge (dimension lines read from drawing; connector long axis parallel to 29 mm edge). Pin-1 marker '1' at the upper end of CN1 in the bottom view.
connector.position_confidence: dimension values are sourced; interpretation that they reference the connector centre is read from the drawing extension lines (pixel check consistent: ~6.1 mm, ~15.6 mm)

alt_higher_stack.note: Hirose: only H=1.5mm type is compatible with Type-C (USB4 Gen2 20Gbps) signal transmission

mating_receptacle_on_VM820C.src: VM820C CN6 description and schematic sheet 4 ('RCPT 100Pin'); MN820 5.3; DF40 catalog p.8/p.10/p.3
mating_receptacle_on_VM820C.pin_mapping: VM820C Table 5 CN6 pinout is identical pin-for-pin to MN820 Table 2

vm820c_3v3_regulator.vm820c_components: L2 6.8uH, Cout 2x22uF (C6,C7), Cin 10uF (C21), FB divider R10 200k / R11 62k, C22 100pF feed-forward, EN tied to VIN
vm820c_3v3_regulator.input: VSYS = USB_5V, DC_IN (4.5-13.5 V), or HOST_5V selected by CN12; USB/Host 5V limited to 500 mA (VM820C 6.2)
vm820c_3v3_regulator.src: VM820C schematic sheet 3 (Power & Audio); AP63200/1/3/5 datasheet p.1

sequencing_reset.module_level: NOT_FOUND (MN820 DS gives no sequencing requirement; single 3.3V input, internal rails generated on-module)
sequencing_reset.RESET_N: BT820: hold RST_N low min 214 us for chip-wide reset (MCU control), or pull up to VCCIO1 via 47k + capacitor. Capacitor value inconsistent in BT820 DS: pin table says '47 KΩ resistor and 1µF', section 4.16.3 says '47KΩ-0.1µF (RC) network'. VM820C uses 47k (R76) + 0.1uF (C62).
sequencing_reset.RC_reset_timing: With RC network, RST_N must de-assert at least 5 ms after Group 4 (1.0V) rails are up (BT820 4.16.3)
sequencing_reset.rail_order_chip: Group1 (VCCIO) before/with Group2 (3.3V analog); Group3 (DDR IO) after/with Group2 and before Group4 (1.0V) (BT820 4.16.3) - handled on-module
sequencing_reset.boot: After RST_N release and init, BT820 stays in SLEEP; host must issue ACTIVE host command (BT820 4.16.4)
sequencing_reset.INT_N: open-drain by default (BT820 4.13); needs pull-up (VM820C uses 10k)
